module_summary: IP-to-Ethernet transmitter: latches parallel IP header fields, an FSM serializes the 20-byte IPv4 header with running one's-complement checksum, then passes payload bytes through a skid-buffered AXI-stream output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: FSM: idle, write header, write payload, last-word hold, wait last

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: IP header valid that triggers header latch and frame start

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready from FSM ready register, accepts next frame header

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload bytes passed through after header

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload valid gating byte transfers and word count

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready from FSM, following output buffer early ready

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of payload; checked against expected word count

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output Ethernet payload: IP header bytes then payload

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling output and temp register moves

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Ethernet header valid asserted when IP header accepted

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready clearing header valid

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Passed-through destination MAC of the Ethernet header

anchors.name: store_ip_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching all IP and Ethernet header fields

anchors.name: ip_length_reg
anchors.why: Latched IP length; representative of header field registers, sets payload count

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header byte index selecting which field byte is emitted

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes, detects early termination and last word

anchors.name: hdr_sum_reg
anchors.why: Running one's-complement IP header checksum, emitted inverted

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Output byte mux: header fields, checksum, payload or held last word

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds last payload byte until frame tlast arrives

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Enables capture of the last payload byte

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready of output buffer gating FSM header emission

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp byte when output stalls

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable of output register from internal datapath

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level when FSM not idle

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error flag when payload tlast arrives before length

groups.name: Frame FSM
groups.description: Sequences header emission, payload pass-through and frame termination

groups.name: Header field registers
groups.description: Latched IP and Ethernet header fields loaded on store_ip_hdr

groups.name: Header serializer and checksum
groups.description: Byte pointer muxing header fields out while summing checksum

groups.name: Payload counter
groups.description: Counts payload bytes against IP length, holds last byte

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register AXI-stream output buffer with early ready

groups.name: Input handshake
groups.description: IP header and payload input handshakes and Ethernet header valid
